text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Trainer. It's okay. You don't have to keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We can still look at them through the glass case. Besides, that was the initial plan, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've proven your commitment, but we should let the next person play now.
